Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale și Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
Hello! We are SKILLD by eJobs and we set out to connect super talents with super companies. At this moment we are looking for a IT Helpdesk Level 2 (M365) with German for the support team, within an international technology company.
 Main responsibilities: 
Contact person for IT enquiries and problems of our employees via telephone, e-mail or ticket system
Remote problem analysis and resolution for all topics related to M365 (Outlook, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams)
Request fulfilment for defined tasks
Qualification and, if necessary, forwarding of tickets to the relevant support groups
Documenting and sharing problems and solutions
 Key Requirements: 
Completed training in the IT sector or comparable qualifications
Very good knowledge of working with and supporting Microsoft 365 applications
Good knowledge of hardware, software and networks
Good knowledge of Windows operating systems
Strong communication skills and customer orientation
Independent and solution-orientated way of working
Ability to work in a team and reliability
German and English language skills
 Benefits: 
Competitive salary and annual performance bonus
Meal vouchers of 40 RON and Medical subscription
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8 hour shift between 8:30 AM and 7:00 PM
A secure and varied role within a dynamic team
Opportunities for continuous training and professional development
Competitive salary and a modern work environment
